tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: O que fez a Ana depois de pensar muito?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Sentes falta da tua família?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue verb belongs to a fixed phrase with a noun (tomar uma decisão, ter saudades, dar um passeio, apresentar queixa, fazer caso). Learn the phrase as one unit: the noun has to go with exactly this verb. Put the verb in the right form, usually in the pretérito perfeito, and add the rest. With dar-se the pronoun changes with the person: dei-me conta. A tile in brackets, like (eu), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Apresentar queixa: é o verbo certo para esta expressão.
